description: What is the postal code / ZIP / postcode / PIN code of a town, and which state, province, region, county, district or local government area is it in? Returns matching places (largest first) with admin1 (state/province/region), admin2 (county/district/LGA), population, coordinates, timezone and postal codes, plus postal codes nearby. Covers every place with 1,000+ people worldwide and every place in GeoNames postal files (124 countries). Use the country argument or "Town, Country" / "Town, State" to disambiguate.

admin.description: Optional state, province, region, county or district to narrow the match, e.g. "Illinois", "Karnataka", "Bayern".

country.description: Optional. Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (AU, US, GB, DE, IN, PH, ...) or an English country name.

name.description: Place name in Latin script, e.g. "Geelong", "Springfield, Illinois", "Kolar, India", "München".

name: find_place
title: Find a place: its state, county or district and postal codes
